entities.title: Render the reference states
entities.summary: Recreate the reference scenario locally and render all 23 states for comparison with docs/screens/.
entities.when: After a change to how anything looks, to check it against the design (docs/DESIGN.md, Acceptance).
steps: npx wrangler d1 execute chess --local --file worker/schema.sql, on a fresh local database
npm run dev, and leave it running
bash scripts/reference/render.sh (Godot 4.7.2 and xvfb-run on the PATH); it writes into docs/screens/
git diff the images, or compare them with the committed ones, masking the areas docs/DESIGN.md lists
entities.verify: render.sh prints ok for every state, and each image matches its reference apart from the masked areas and antialiasing.
